column1: # Version-pin registry — the ONLY place a tool version may legitimately deviate
# from the repo's canonical (latest-adopted) version.
# POLICY (enforced by //tools/conformance:check): the monorepo runs ONE canonical
# version per tool — the latest it has adopted — sourced live from:
#     go    -> the `go X.Y.Z` directive in go.work
#     node  -> the major of .nvmrc
#     pnpm  -> the `packageManager` "pnpm@X.Y.Z" in the root package.json
# The DEFAULT is that every file MATCHES canonical. This is NOT a static allowlist:
# a row here is a deliberate, TEMPORARY, JUSTIFIED pin that must be reviewed and
# DELETED once its constraint no longer holds. The checker FAILS on:
#   - undeclared drift (a file matches neither canonical nor a registered pin),
#   - a STALE pin (its file now matches canonical — the pin is no longer needed),
#   - a pin past its review_by date (re-justify or remove),
#   - a registry row that disagrees with the file it names (pinned_value != found),
#   - a malformed row (missing column / bad date) — fix the row.
# So this file both BLOCKS silent drift AND nags every pin toward removal.
# FORMAT: columns separated by any whitespace (the .tsv extension is nominal),
# aligned with spaces for readability. The parser skips `#` comment and blank
# lines and splits on runs of whitespace, so values must NOT contain spaces
# EXCEPT the final `reason` column (free text, always last). Columns:
#   file          workspace-relative path to the file carrying the pinned version
#   tool          one of: go | node | pnpm
#   pinned_value  the version the file is currently pinned to (must equal what the
#                 file actually says; for node this is the major, e.g. 20)
#   review_by     ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) by which the pin must be re-justified or removed
#   owner         who owns retiring this pin (e.g. @james)
#   reason        free text justification (may contain spaces; MUST be the last column)
# file                    tool  pinned_value  review_by   owner   reason
